--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CLT_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CLT_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CLT_ID ORDER BY [FILE_NAME] DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.ATM_CLIENT_WITH_DUP_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT_WITH_DUP_20240321;

--5 CREATE BU TABLE
SELECT * INTO BUSC.ATM_CLIENT_BU_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT;

--6 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.ATM_CLIENT_WITH_DUP_20240321 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_CLIENT; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--8 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_CLIENT --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT 
CLT_ID
,CLT_UUID
,CLT_INS_ID
,CLT_BRN_ID
,CLT_CIF_NUMBER
,CLT_PARENT_CLT_ID
,CLT_TITLE
,CLT_FIRST_NAME
,CLT_LAST_NAME
,CLT_GENDER
,CLT_DOB
,CLT_EMBOSSING_NAME
,CLT_MOBILE_NUMBER
,CLT_OTHER_NUMBER
,CLT_EMAIL_ADDRESS
,CLT_MARITAL_STATUS
,CLT_MOTHER_MAIDEN_NAME
,CLT_DOC_ID
,CLT_ID_PROOF
,CLT_STS_ID
,CLT_CREATED_BY
,CLT_CREATED_TS
,CLT_UPDATED_BY
,CLT_UPDATED_TS
,CLT_AUDIT_LOG
,CLT_CCL_ID
,CLT_NATIONALITY
,CLT_ID_PROOF_DOC
,CLT_MIDDLE_NAME
,CLT_WORK_PHONE_NO
,CLT_KEY_ROTATION_NO
,CLT_CAF_UPDATE
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT_WITH_DUP_20240321; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records

--9 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CLT_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CLT_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--10 COUNT TARGET
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT;

--11 COUNT DUPS
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT_WITH_DUP_20240321
